_about: Public-domain Francis Atterbury (1663-1732), Bishop of Rochester, High Church controversialist, for the Word Hoard: his Sermons and Discourses on Several Subjects and Occasions (London, volumes 1-2 of 1740 and 3-4 of 1745), from Internet Archive scans of Eighteenth Century Collections Online. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 44 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

atterbury-sermons-1: Sermons and Discourses on Several Subjects and Occasions, vol. 1 (London, catalogued 1740)
atterbury-sermons-2: Sermons and Discourses on Several Subjects and Occasions, vol. 2 (London, catalogued 1740)
atterbury-sermons-3: Sermons and Discourses on Several Subjects and Occasions, vol. 3 (London, catalogued 1745)
atterbury-sermons-4: Sermons and Discourses on Several Subjects and Occasions, vol. 4 (London, catalogued 1745)

_alternates.atterbury-copies: Other printings of the Sermons (1723-1774); the Epistolary Correspondence (Nichols, 1783-1787), letters to and from him with editorial notes, left for a later round

_excluded.atterbury-other: Lewis Atterbury's Sermons (his brother); the Virgil translation volumes; the Convocation pamphlets of 1700-1702 (church politics)
